resources.string: Each person chosen receives the group\'s key in one transaction from you. Then every message is a single transaction, whatever the group\'s size. Members see the group in this app only, not on idena.social.
Saving hands a new key to the people kept and added. People removed read nothing sent after that; people added read from now on.

resources.string: a group holds 1 to %1$d people besides you
only the person who created the group can change it
%1$s gave the group a new key
The group will see that you left, and you will no longer be able to write in it. Its creator can then hand out a new key without you.
You are no longer in this group.

Only the group\'s members can read its messages. Who writes and when is public, on the chain for good. The group\'s name and members are not; how many they are shows each time its creator hands out a key.
